claim_text: Almost 130,000 utility customers had lost power in Hawaii, Al Jazeera reported on 16 August 2026 citing Reuters, as Lala weakened from a Category 1 hurricane to a tropical storm south of the islands.
quote: Almost 130,000 utility customers lost power, Reuters reported.
confidence_justification: Second-hand wire figure that is substantially lower than counts reported the same day by other outlets, indicating differing snapshot times.
